Nation pays homage to language martyrs
2022-02-21T20:26:37+06:00 | Star Newsbytes
https://www.thedailystar.net/star-multimedia/news-multimedia/news/nation-pays-homage-language-martyrs-2967316

All around the country, people from all walks of life, along with various political, social, and cultural groups, have paid homage to the language martyrs. People gathered at the Shaheed Minar today with flowers to pay tribute to the martyrs.
